items.title: style: rustfmt walker.rs
items.scope: Standalone pure-format commit so later logic diffs stay clean (legacy let-else formatting at base).
items.risk: None (formatting only); must contain no logic change.

items.title: feat(rules): exclude-hidden pattern + protects allowlist
items.scope: Rule gains exclude_hidden: Option<bool> + protects: Option<Vec<PathBuf>> (serde default, ts(optional), absent=off); pinned semantics: real-dot-dirs only (symlinks not matched), if_exists gates hidden matching, protects blocks Add but not Remove; ShallowEntry carries is_dir through both walk paths; generate_diff change applies to BOTH walks; RuleItem.tsx spread-preserves at its two edit sites (type-switch site keeps fresh defaults); Hidden rule ships commented out in config.example.yaml.
items.risk: jwalk 0.8.1 file_type verified (public field, non-Result); std path degrades conservatively; frontend literals stay type-valid via ts(optional) and runtime strip fixed via spread-preserve (D6).

items.title: perf(watcher): batch coalescing + in-flight guard + bounded pending set
items.scope: One spawn_blocking per delivered FSEvent batch; dedup + ancestor-first depth ordering; AtomicUsize in-flight guard (max 2, drop-guard decrement); overflow batches merge (with dedup) into a single bounded pending path set (MAX_PENDING_PATHS = 65536, cap-exceeding paths dropped with warn), the set swapping out as one batch when in-flight falls below cap; symlink_metadata deleted-path fast path; keeps existing walk_non_recursive signature.
items.risk: Loss mode is missed Adds (no_include discards Removes anyway); residual only where the path cap forced drops (warn-logged) or on crash/quit before drain; manual full scan is the startup-independent corrective.

odp_status.resolution: MAX_IN_FLIGHT_BATCHES starts at 2; tune only if real workloads show starvation (deferred, re-surfaces downstream).

items.title: perf(walker): rule-name prefilter gated on no_include
items.scope: walk_non_recursive gains no_include param; after read_dir, skip per-entry getxattr when no rule-relevant name and no dot-dir is present (no_include=true); dummy Included state for if_exists markers and protects entries; watcher call site updated here.
items.risk: Prefilter unsoundness (missed Add) mitigated by deriving the name set from the same applicable-rule filtering generate_diff uses; full-scan backstop.
